cases.scope: At the clip opening, distinguish the upper numeric ability mana-cost text from a centered countdown overlay on the icon.

evidence.cue: Native HUD displays upper-right costs above Q/W/E/R icons; any countdown numeral is separately centered on a blue cooldown overlay.
Adjacent native frame preserves upper cost numeral position distinct from centered cooldown numeral where present.

cases.reason: Upper cost numerals (25/30/35/40/70/100) are spatially separate from countdown overlay digits; upper number alone is not countdown.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not read the upper corner cost as an active cooldown timer.

cases.scope: Q and E are already cooling down at the clip opening; sampled displays show continuing ordinary countdown.

evidence.cue: Q has centered cooldown numeral 2 and E has centered cooldown numeral 11; upper cost numerals remain above the icons.
Q center numeral decrements to 1 while E continues its centered cooldown display.

cases.reason: Cooldown is present at first sample and persists/decrements across adjacent native samples.
cases.forbidden_claim: Do not treat these ongoing cooldown ticks as fresh ability uses.

notes: Overview samples show selected Darius gameplay with movement/combat context varying by clip. Sampling is 4 fps; intermediate actions and exact onset timing remain unknown. No quiet claim is made. Native opening pair confirms separation of upper mana-cost numerals from centered cooldown timer numerals where shown.
